scaling._comment: Scaled take-profit. Banks tp1_fraction at tp1_r and moves the stop to breakeven plus a tick, so a setup whose nearest opposing liquidity sits under min_rr becomes tradeable instead of rejected. Outcomes stop being binary, so EV is measured as mean realized R.

ev_gate._comment: Expected-value gate. EV is measured from the scanner's own resolved setups, not from level base rates — a level's sweep frequency is not this strategy's win rate. Fails closed below min_sample: an unmeasured edge is not a passing one.

crypto._comment: Binance USDT-M perpetual costs. Fees are a share of NOTIONAL per side, so at BTC prices they dominate every other cost term and dwarf a tight stop. 4.5 bps is standard taker; maker is ~2.0, and lower again with BNB or volume tiers. This single number decides whether a 5m crypto strategy can clear its own costs — set it to what you actually pay.

futures._comment: YOUR broker's costs. These feed every R:R and cost-drag number. Defaults are assumed retail all-in per round turn — replace with your actual fills.
